hpe_js_mutation_state.brief: 取（必要时创建）解释器的观察者登记状态 / Get, creating on demand, the interpreter's observer bookkeeping state

params.js: JS 运行时上下文，可为 `NULL` / JS runtime context, may be `NULL`

hpe_js_mutation_state.return: 解释器级状态块；`js` 为 `NULL` 时返回 `NULL` / The per-interpreter state block, or `NULL` when `js` is `NULL`
hpe_js_mutation_state.note: 状态块由 arena 分配，字段含观察者链表、所属 `js` 与 `sink_installed` / The arena-allocated block holds the observer list, the owning `js` and `sink_installed`

hpe_js_mutation_install.brief: 注册 DOM 变更接收器并安装全局 `MutationObserver` / Register the DOM mutation sink and install the global `MutationObserver`

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context

hpe_js_mutation_uninstall.brief: 注销 DOM 变更接收器 / Unregister the DOM mutation sink

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context

hpe_js_mutation_uninstall.note: 由 `hpe_js_mutation_install` 注册的接收器在此摘除 / Removes the sink registered by `hpe_js_mutation_install`

hpe_js_mutation_install_ctor.brief: 安装全局 `MutationObserver` 构造器 / Install the global `MutationObserver` constructor

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
